subject: Notice: new tertiary processor — EdgeFlow Analytics (request for impact assessment)
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@fintrust.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: fintrust-security@fintrust.com
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Notice: EdgeFlow Analytics added to FinTrust processing roster

Hi Logan —

Quick heads up: FinTrust has added a tertiary telemetry processor to our roster for the Metric Aggregation pipeline. Company: EdgeFlow Analytics (EU-only tenant). They will receive anonymized service telemetry and aggregate metrics for dashboarding and alerting.

Summary:
- Processor: EdgeFlow Analytics
- Purpose: aggregate anonymized telemetry (latency, success/error counts, sampling of anonymized traces)
- Data categories: service telemetry, request metadata (no PII, no customer content)
- Residency: EU data centers only (primary: Frankfurt, secondary: Amsterdam)
- Retention: 30 days for aggregated metrics; logs trimmed to 7 days
- Onboarding docs attached: EdgeFlow-processor-brief.pdf, data-flow-diagram.png

Please let us know if Redwood requires any additional artifacts (DPA addendum, SOC report, proof of EU-only processing). We can route an addendum for signature if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Vendor Risk Lead — FinTrust
elena.ruiz@fintrust.com

[Attachment: EdgeFlow-processor-brief.pdf (summary), data-flow-diagram.png]
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@fintrust.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Notice: EdgeFlow Analytics added to FinTrust processing roster

Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and the attachments. A couple quick clarifying asks so we can route to Legal and Security: 

1) Can you confirm there is no customer content or user-uploaded data in the feed? Is it strictly service telemetry (metrics/traces) produced by FinTrust services?
2) Where is the processing control plane located (EU-only)? Any fallback to US/other regions?
3) Are there subprocessor subcontractors (e.g., cloud provider partners) we should be aware of?
4) Do you have a proposed DPA addendum we can review (or a DocuSign link)?

If possible attach the minimal evidence pack (data-flow diagram + short attestation from EdgeFlow about EU-only processing). I'll loop Legal (Kimberly) and Procurement (Marissa) to confirm whether this fits our DPA addendum thresholds.

Thanks — we'll triage within 48 hours.

Best,
Logan Wright
Platform Security PM — Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@fintrust.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: fintrust-security@fintrust.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Notice: EdgeFlow Analytics added to FinTrust processing roster

On Sat, 27 Jun 2026 at 16:12:00 +0000, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@fintrust.com> wrote:
> Quick heads up: FinTrust has added a tertiary telemetry processor...

Hi Logan / Kimberly / Marissa —

Answers inline: 
1) Data types: confirmed — strictly anonymized telemetry and aggregated metrics. No customer content, no PII, no KYC data.
2) Residency: EdgeFlow has committed to EU-only processing and has contractual controls with their cloud provider to restrict compute to EU regions. We have the provider-level MSA confirming region controls (attached). No automatic fallback to non-EU regions.
3) Sub-subprocessors: EdgeFlow uses FastStore (object storage) and MeshMetrics (stats pipeline). Both are disclosed in their vendor brief; both operate within EU zones for this integration.
4) DPA addendum: attached edgeflow-dpa-addendum.pdf and a short attestation. We can issue a DocuSign for Redwood if you prefer: https://docusign.net/link/edgeflow-addendum

Attachment summary: edgeflow-dpa-addendum.pdf (DPA addendum draft), EdgeFlow-processor-brief.pdf (capabilities), data-flow-diagram.png (shows consumer -> EdgeFlow EU cluster -> aggregation -> FinTrust dashboards)

If Redwood needs SOC2 / ISO evidence we can request a temporary snapshot from EdgeFlow — they are mid-audit but can provide encrypted logs export on request.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Vendor Risk Lead — FinTrust

[Attachment: edgeflow-dpa-addendum.pdf]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Legal Team <legal@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 12:45:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Notice: EdgeFlow Analytics added to FinTrust processing roster — proposed next steps

Team —

Thanks Logan / Elena for the rapid responses. Based on the packet, proposed actions: 

- Condition acceptance on signing the DPA addendum (edgeflow-dpa-addendum.pdf). Use the DocuSign link provided and require an explicit EU-only processing clause and prohibition on using customer content for training.
- Request the temporary SOC/ISO snapshot for our security review (Elena offered this).
- Ask EdgeFlow to provide a short list of sub-subprocessors with contract redlines showing EU residency guarantees (FastStore, MeshMetrics).
- Update our vendor roster and the cross-border matrix once DPA is signed and SOC snapshot validated.

Logan / Marissa: can you create a brief entry in the vendor tracker with the attachments and link to Drive? I put the proposed artifacts in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cedgeflow (access request pending).

Elena: once we have the signed addendum and SOC snapshot, we can close the triage. Please notify us if EdgeFlow introduces any new downstream processors.

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

[Attachment: internal onboarding checklist referenced]
